in_ClaimDataJSON.description: Claim details extracted on previous steps

in_AssessmentReportJSON.description: Validated assessor report converted to structured JSON.

in_EligibilityDecision.description: The human reviewer's decision at the eligibility gateway. An approval makes every finding in in_EligibilityChecksJSON a granted exception, not an open breach.

in_EligibilityNotes.description: The reviewer's own note explaining that decision. Where it contradicts a finding, the note wins.

in_PreviousClaimsJSON.description: The insurer's claims system, queried for this policy, as JSON text. priorClaims: [] means it was asked and there are none.

out_CredibilityChecksJSON.description: Credibility Analysis Results Check envelope — see contracts/check-envelope.md. Every string is shown to a human reviewer.

verdict.description: pass when nothing needs a human; attention when a reviewer should look; fail when this analysis blocks the claim.

headline.description: One line the reviewer can act on. States the reason, not the outcome.

summary.description: Your reasoning. Replaces the separate summary output that used to exist.

checks.description: One entry per thing you checked, reported whether it passed or not.

label.description: Sentence case, written for a claims reviewer. Never a payload field name.

status.description: warn when satisfied only with a caveat, or when data needed for the check was unavailable.

verdict.description: The one-line result shown beside the label.

details.description: Supporting evidence for this check, up to 6 rows. Supply it for every check, passing ones included — a reviewer can expand a passing check to see what was compared.
